title: India-China trade jumps 29% to $91.76 billion, overtakes US in first half of FY27

Exports to various countries, including Singapore and Tanzania, showed substantial growth. However, imports from some nations declined during this period. Overall, projections for India's merchandise exports remain optimistic as growth trends continue.

title: US temple attack plot: Teen’s alleged manifesto describes Indians as ‘subhumans’
description: A 19-year-old white supremacist's intention to attack a temple near Chicago was disrupted by a rifle malfunction. Following the incident, concerned colleagues notified authorities after he expressed his intentions via messages. Police arrested Alexandros Paporakis, uncovering alarming materials including a manifesto that targeted several communities. The case has raised serious safety concerns among Hindu organizations about worship places.

title: Is Dhanush ready to make his political debut? Fan club's new avatar sparks buzz
description: Dhanush's fan club has evolved into the Dhanush Narpani Iyakkam, signaling possible political ambitions. The organization plans to set up local welfare units in five assembly constituencies within Coimbatore district. This transition involves the introduction of a new logo and flag, streamlining its identity. Although comparisons with Vijay's political path are inevitable, Dhanush has not made any official announcements regarding his political intentions, fueling speculation about his future moves.

Van Gogh painting unseen for 60 years resurfaces with $180 million estimate

With an estimated value of around $180 million, this piece could shatter records. Once acquired in 1975, it has remained within the Blaquier family collection, drawing excitement from collectors, particularly during the recent preview in Hong Kong.

Friends put $5,000 each into RXBAR; four years later, Kellogg bought it for $600m

Starting from Rahal's parents' basement, they sold directly to customers. Their venture gained tremendous traction, culminating in a $600 million acquisition by the Kellogg Company in 2017, highlighting a significant trend towards clean-label snacks. Rahal remained CEO for two years post-acquisition before transitioning out.

title: Rohit's 5th ton, 2 Super Overs: A look back at last T20I in Bengaluru ahead of WI decider

title: Video: Loud booms rock Yemen presidential palace as Houthis fire several missiles
description: Amid the raging battle against Saudi Arabia, the attack gains significance as the palace houses the internationally recognised government, which also has the firm backing of the Kingdom. The Houthis began attacking Saudi territory and blocking the Red Sea in solidarity with Iran, which has been continuously bombed by the US and Israel to dissuade the Islamic regime from enriching uranium to acquire nuclear weapons.

title: Jammed gun thwarts massacre of Indians at Hindu temple near Chicago
description: A young man in Illinois was arrested for allegedly planning a mass shooting at a Hindu temple. His co-workers became concerned after he made alarming comments about killing Indians. The incident highlights rising xenophobia and anti-India sentiment in the United States. India's ministry of external affairs expressed the need for enhanced vigilance against hate-motivated violence. Authorities are expected to thoroughly investigate and take measures to ensure the Indian community's safety.

title: In Claude We Trust: Can 'God' save frontier models?
description: In this edition, we are going to look at how Anthropic is now hoping to get a little spiritual cred for its frontier models, and by doing so, they are channelling the kings of yore, who, despite their armies and gold, always wanted a divine mandate to rule. And will then ponder: how will we ever know when a machine becomes conscious?

title: Karnataka woman stabbed to death by husband with broken beer bottle at Andhra lodge
description: A middle-aged woman named Rubiya Tej was allegedly murdered by her husband in Madanapalle. The incident occurred inside a lodge and involved a beer bottle. The couple had been married for 13 years and had four children together. Police suspect marital discord as a possible motive for the murder, although specifics remain unclear.

title: Amit Shah vows to clear every trace of Naxalism after decades of tribal suffering
description: Amit Shah highlighted the importance of eradicating Naxalism to restore growth in Bastar, Chhattisgarh. He noted that significant efforts had been made in this regard by local tribal leadership. Shah mentioned a distribution program of assistive devices benefiting over 3,600 disabled individuals, particularly Naxal violence victims. He emphasized the need to heal the wounds from years of suffering while maintaining that Naxalism's end does not restore dignity immediately.

title: SC seeks Centre’s response on plea to hold protest organisers liable for damage
description: The Supreme Court has requested responses regarding a plea to hold protest organizers accountable for damages. This includes potential liabilities for loss of life, injuries, and property damage incurred during protests. Additionally, the plea advocates for designated protest locations to minimize disturbances in densely populated areas. It proposes that protest organizers disclose their funding sources to ensure transparency.

title: Dog survives 34 days alone in Yellowstone, losing nearly half her weight
description: In an extraordinary survival story, Luna, a spirited Jack Russell terrier, went missing from her family's cabin in Yellowstone National Park for 34 days. Rescuers launched an intensive search, leading to her discovery on October 14, right before the onset of winter conditions. Although significantly weakened, Luna's return was met with joy and gratitude, both for her family and the devoted rescuers who never gave up on her.

title: France begins implementing agreement to protect Saudi oil facilities; what it means
description: France has started deploying military resources to Saudi Arabia to protect its oil facilities from regional attacks. This decision follows an agreement aimed at enhancing defense cooperation, especially amid increased drone and missile threats. President Emmanuel Macron confirmed the deployment, which includes soldiers and defense systems to bolster security. Recent attacks by Houthi militants have escalated tensions in the area, raising concerns for energy stability.

This donation was intended to help families facing food insecurity amidst ongoing pandemic challenges. Herbert emphasized the importance of community service, inspired by his parents' values. The Food Bank has been a crucial support system for families in need since 1973.

title: Mumbai shocker: CCTV clip shows 10-year-old pushing 18-month-old off 6th floor duct

Intended to convey the triumph of cleanliness over corruption, the event will also include classic effigies like Ravan and Meghnad. Amidst the festivities, the Cockroach Janata Party's protests highlight ongoing political discontent, merging tradition with modern issues.

Her decision to retire after 13 years in civil service aligns with a trend of bureaucrats entering politics.

EC announces Special Summary Revision of voters' list in 17 states amid SIR row
description: While a Summary Revision focuses on new eligibles and routine corrections, SIR goes far deeper, involving statewide house-to-house verification, detailed scrutiny of entries, and large-scale data audits. For instance, under a Summary Revision, a voter who has shifted homes must file a form to update their address. Under SIR, the Booth Level Officer visits that address, confirms whether the voter still lives there, checks if anyone new has become eligible, and updates the roll based on physical verification rather than waiting for the voter to initiate the change.

title: President accepts L Murugan’s resignation amid buzz over Union Cabinet reshuffle
Lula or Bolsonaro: Why Brazil's presidential election matters for Brics and India
description: Brics began with five members and grew to eleven after the 2024 expansion, with Indonesia the newest, joining in 2025. Brazil opposed the enlargement, particularly because of the one nation. Iran. It feared that adding the avowedly anti-West Islamic Republic would cost the group its cohesion. Like India, Brazil wants Brics to be reformist and not revolutionary, thereby limiting it to a body that argues for change inside the existing order rather than one that tries to replace it.

title: 'We all want regime change, anything wrong?' Bhushan attacks govt; BJP hits back
George Lucas’ 23-acre San Francisco campus now has 4 buildings and 17-acre meadow
description: In the heart of San Francisco, the former military hospital site has been ingeniously repurposed into the Letterman Digital Arts Center. This vibrant digital arts hub, established by George Lucas in 2005 post-demolition, now serves as a creative haven for Lucasfilm and other innovative firms. Careful attention to open spaces fosters community interaction and leisure, showcasing a successful model for urban redevelopment and creative collaborations.

title: California man turned discarded bottles and scrap into Route 66 desert art forest
description: California cement worker Elmer Long transformed discarded glass bottles and scrap metal into an unusual art forest along Route 66. His two-acre Bottle Tree Ranch, featuring around 200 trees and over 1,000 bottles, became a popular tourist attraction. As Route 66 celebrates its 100th anniversary in 2026, Long's family continues to preserve his creations.

title: Philadelphia artist turned junk into 3,000-sq-ft maze now drawing sellout crowds
description: Philadelphia's Magic Gardens, a vibrant masterpiece by Isaiah Zagar, comprises stunning mosaics made from found objects that capture his personal journey and artistic influences. In 2004, when demolition loomed, local advocates banded together to form a nonprofit, securing the beloved site. Over the years, Zagar enriched the gardens with imaginative tunnels and diverse mosaics, right up to his death in 2026.

title: Travis Kelce faces scrutiny: What do tax records reveal about his charity spending?
description: Travis Kelce faces scrutiny after an Arizona Republic investigation raised concerns about spending and governance at his Eighty-Seven and Running Foundation. Tax records indicated that only 41 cents of every dollar went towards charitable activities between 2021 and 2024. Kelce’s representatives blamed reporting errors, saying management fees fell to zero in 2025. The foundation also plans to expand its board and improve financial reporting to strengthen transparency and accountability.

title: Stage 4 oral cancer survivor, 57, rebuilds strength and now deadlifts 80 kg
description: After battling stage 4 oral cancer while enduring pain for years, Javitri Shakya found strength through the unwavering support of her son, Manish. He paused his singing career to focus on her recovery, even crafting homemade gym equipment to aid in her rehabilitation. Remarkably, Javitri has progressed to deadlifting 80 kg, proving that with resilience and relentless effort, a rebirth of life is achievable for cancer patients.

title: Why New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani wants 15% of whatever NYU’s new quantum lab invents
description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has committed $29.2 million to NYU's Quantum Fabrication Facility (QFab) in Manhattan, set to open in 2030. In return, the city gets 15% of NYU's proceeds from intellectual property created with city-funded tools, plus three advisory board seats. Backed by $284 million in total funding, the new quantum lab will train CUNY students and support more than 100 companies.

description: Zimbabwe will co-host the 2027 ODI World Cup with South Africa and Namibia. For the 40-year-old all-rounder, the tournament will offer an opportunity to play a World Cup on home soil towards the end of his career.

title: Michael Dell loses $20 billion in one day after Barclays downgrade
description: Michael Dell experienced a substantial decline in net worth, dropping more than $20 billion in just one day. This decline was prompted by a major decrease in his company's stock value following an analyst downgrade. Earlier this year, Dell's net worth had notably increased, bringing him closer to the highest billionaires in the world.

title: No more guessing who's calling! Govt mandates caller ID display from Nov 1
description: The Department of Telecommunications is preparing to roll out Calling Name Presentation, a feature that shows the caller's name in addition to their number on the recipient's screen. This functionality will first be implemented on 4G networks before extending to other versions. Users will have the choice to opt-out if they utilize the calling line identification restriction service, striking a balance between enhancing caller recognition and safeguarding data privacy.

title: SA drop Stubbs after Durban drubbing; call up Breetzke and eye Rabada return
description: The changes are likely to bring a reshuffle in South Africa's batting order for the Test, which starts on Sunday. Conrad also confirmed that Ryan Rickelton will take over as wicketkeeper.

title: Imran Khan asked to leave India: What rights do OCI cardholders have?
description: Actor Imran Khan faces deportation from India by October 28 due to his involvement in a protest. This action stems from a complaint lodged by BJP leader Kirit Somaiya regarding legal violations during the demonstration. Khan, a US citizen and OCI cardholder, was detained at the protest site in Mumbai. His participation raises questions about the rights of foreign nationals involved in political activities.
